title: A test-author may commit a merge whose docs/records.md equals the merged base's page
why: When a lane merges main and its branch carries a docs/records.md row, no role can commit the merge: the records-page rule refuses the test-author, and builder-cannot-edit-tests refuses the builder.
note: Lane verdict-format-line, 04:13 CST Nov 9. Incident: #1913 at 03:50 CST; the test-author was refused on both acts, which led to the plumbing-built commit in step role-guard-plumbing-bypass. #1521 changes only the role paths, not the records-page rule in hooks/guard.py (lane mixed-merge-no-role, 04:15 CST). Proposed fix: the records-page rule accepts a merge whose docs/records.md equals the merged base's blob exactly (the rule's own stated remedy), and the test-author may run `git checkout <base> -- docs/records.md` for that one path during a merge. Unassigned; the coordinator routes it. Doing in lane session_013NEJL3qKvwXBThPagV7fsa (coordinator, 05:43 CST Nov 9), started before batch 68 merges because of the incident count. Ready at #2433, released for batch 69 (coordinator, 07:12 CST Nov 9). Notes for this step's follow-up or the next guard_merge.py lane: (1) guard_merge.py records_page_hit's comment says "Any read that fails is no hit", but the two new reads fail closed. Fix: say "Any other read". (2) No case or mutant pins a failed first-parent read (probed: refused, not a hole). Fix: add one red case.
